# Paramveer Singh Bhele

> Software engineer building AI systems, backend infrastructure, and production products.

Paramveer Singh Bhele is a University of South Florida Computer Science graduate and Columbia University M.S. Artificial Intelligence student focused on AI Infrastructure.

Seeking Summer 2027 software engineering and applied AI internships, especially backend systems, AI infrastructure, and model workflows. Portfolio information and the resume PDF updated September 30, 2026.

## Selected work

- [Polaris](https://github.com/Param-10/hackthebay): GitHub App combining deterministic Infrastructure-as-Code scanning, Gemini reasoning and independent verification, mechanical patch checks, and developer approval. Paramveer built the FastAPI backend and dual-agent Gemini system, including persistent scan jobs and a retrying GitHub reporting outbox. [Live demo](https://polaris-livid-one.vercel.app/) · [Devpost](https://devpost.com/software/polaris-szhivy)
- [PR Nutrition](https://github.com/Param-10/pr-nutrition): Local-first TypeScript CLI and GitHub Action that prioritizes pull-request review risk and points reviewers to the changes that deserve attention first. [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/pr-nutrition)
- [Adversarial Spam Detection](https://github.com/Param-10/adversarial-spam-detection): AI4ALL team project exploring BERT classification and Qwen3-4B/LoRA adversarial examples. Corrected September 26, 2026 clean test results: BERT 98.2% accuracy / 0.92 spam F1 versus SVM 96.6% / 0.83 on the same 762-message test partition, with model selection on validation. Paramveer contributed as part of the AI4ALL team. These clean-test metrics do not establish adversarial robustness.
- [CarbonCTRL](https://github.com/Param-10/CarbonCTRL): Carbon management platform and winner of the MLH Best Use of Gemini API award at HackaBull 2025. Current stack: React, TypeScript, Node.js/Express, SQLite/Drizzle, emission-factor calculations, and Gemini recommendations. Optional Python forecasting and ML routes remain in the repository; Supabase and MongoDB describe earlier versions. [Devpost](https://devpost.com/software/carbonctrl)
- [Coefficient Software Systems](https://coefficientindia.com/): Production corporate website rebuilt with Astro, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, GSAP, and Lenis. [Source](https://github.com/Param-10/bluewave-revamp)

## Other work

- [BullRunner](https://param-10.github.io/bullrunner-2/): Map-first USF transit application using live Passio data. [Source](https://github.com/Param-10/bullrunner-2)
- [Fraud Detection Dashboard](https://fraud-detector-dashboard.netlify.app/): Transaction CSV dashboard and risk visualizations. The live browser demo uses heuristic scoring with illustrative weights; the separate Python/Dash backend contains the trained Scikit-learn model workflow. [Source](https://github.com/Param-10/Fraud-Detection-Dashboard)
- [Focus](https://github.com/Param-10/Focus-Timer-Extension): Current Pomodoro extension source with browser-alarm scheduling, notifications, and local-only settings. The earlier store release is named [Focus Timer PRO](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/focus-timer-pro/bbmnnmmfgdefdhipfjiefioodbfhohde).

## Experience

- Student Assistant — Digital Initiatives, University of South Florida Libraries (Aug 2024–May 2026)
- Machine Learning Engineer Intern, Finds, Inc. (Oct 2025–Jan 2026): Integrated in-house ML into Python/PostgreSQL services for app beta testing and clothing visual search; extracted and processed approximately 5,000 clothing-product links, typically with two to three images each.
- Undergraduate Research Assistant, Reality, Autonomy, and Robot Experience (RARE) Lab at USF (Feb–Jul 2025): Built the complete Android recipe recommendation app and Raspberry Pi backend, including UI screens, APIs, and SQLite storage to coordinate Gemini responses and Misty robot interactions. Ran participant studies, analyzed behavioral data, and contributed to a human-robot interaction research manuscript.
- Peer Mentor, USF College of Engineering (Apr 2023–Aug 2024)
- App Developer Intern, Coefficient Software Systems (May–Jul 2022)
